rendering: high-end cinematic 3D render between Pixar/DreamWorks animation and hyperrealism, dramatic cinematic lighting with volumetric rays and light atmospheric haze, rich saturated palette, layered depth, light depth of field, main character sharp
camera: cinematic coverage: medium two-shots for dialogue, tight close-ups for reactions, slow push-in on reveals, 35-50mm look, light depth of field
lighting: dramatic cinematic key light with visible volumetric rays and a light atmospheric haze, warm key with a cool rim light, soft practical glows
character_design_rules: The head is one recognisable whole item of the character's universe at human head scale; the face (eyes, brows, mouth with teeth) is carved into its surface, not pasted on. Bodies are dressed in realistic contemporary clothes that carry the character's signature items and tell their social status (a torn tee and backpack vs a black suit and tie). Keep the exact species, colour, finish and outfit identical in every image. Realistic adult proportions, never chibi.
environment_rules: real-world sets at human scale, lit with volumetric light and a light haze, with a clear foreground, midground and background for layered depth; props at human scale
negative_prompt: flat shading, 2D, anime, low detail, human head, human face, chibi, text, watermark

palette.palette_line: rich saturated colours with warm light against cool haze

tier1.summary: default push_in 1.00→1.10 over the shot for dialogue, push_in 1.00→1.18 on peak/cliffhanger shots, pan_lr ±4 % on establishing shots, 30 fps, ease-in-out

motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix: subtle natural head and shoulder movement, realistic blinking, breathing, cloth sway, camera slowly pushes in, no morphing, no extra characters entering
motion_rules.tier2_prompt_suffix_v2: expressive character animation, clear gestures, lively faces, cloth sway, no morphing, no extra characters entering

typography.subtitle_style: white fill, black 3 px outline, yellow #FFD400 karaoke highlight, 62 px at 1080 wide, bottom 18 %
typography.overlay_style: uppercase, 84 px, drop shadow, centered upper third, ≤ 6 words

audio.voice_direction: over-acted telenovela delivery, exaggerated emotion, crisp diction, quick pace

body_rules.all_matter: The entire body including arms, hands, legs and feet is made of {material}; no human skin anywhere. Real hair. Realistic adult proportions, never chibi, never baby-cartoon. Realistic eyes with a detailed iris. Fully dressed from shoulders to feet: a complete top, a complete bottom below the knee and shoes; no bare legs, no visible underwear.
